hook: AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay when you needed a yes or a no.
caption:
AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay when you needed a yes or a no.

You asked: "Should I take this job offer?"

Generic AI said: *Here are the key factors to consider when evaluating a career opportunity. First, compensation packages often include... Second, company culture plays a vital role in... Third, growth trajectory should be weighed against...*

You closed the tab.

Here's the thing — the AI wasn't wrong. It just doesn't know you're a decisive, gut-first thinker who already researched the company for three hours and just needs someone to pressure-test your instinct.

It doesn't know you hate bullet points.
It doesn't know you want pushback, not validation.
It doesn't know that "helpful" for you means sharp and direct, not thorough and safe.

So it defaulted to the version of helpful that offends no one and helps no one.

That's the gap bootfile.ai exists to close.

Your BootFile tells AI how your brain actually works — your thinking style, your communication preferences, your decision-making pattern. So instead of getting the answer built for everyone, you get the answer built for you.

Short when you need short.
Blunt when you need blunt.
Challenge-first when that's what actually moves you forward.

The AI was never the problem. It just didn't know you yet.
